title: JA Kinetic wp7 1.1.7: footer columns keep one line per title and link at 320px, and the 404 footer rows match the source
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout read the shipped theme packages/cms/tracy-wordpress-theme/src/wp-ja-kinetic (style.css, assets/css/wp-ja-kinetic.css) and its overlay under overlays/wp-ja-kinetic.

S2: Read the release's recorded site sweep tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/fix-measure.json (taken on a clean restore of the 1.0.5 pack against the local Joomla source stand) and tasks/ja-kinetic-wp7/release/SHA256SUMS.
expect: S1: the theme is version 1.1.7; the shipped stylesheet and the overlay both keep footer titles and links on one line, size the three footer columns to their content, and pad the footer link rows 9.15px.
S2: the sweep was taken by site-sweep.mjs on the released theme zip, passes 11 of 11 checks with 0 heights defects, and its baseline is 1.1.6 with heights failing.
evidence: Release chain of 06/10/2026 against the local Joomla source, theme 1.1.7: full 11-check site-sweep (30/30 routes, 584s) passed with 0 open groups, accepted groups only the search result count, the Contact mailbox column and the profile alert band; measure115 9/9 earlier the same day on the same theme CSS
fence: The shipped stylesheet carries the rules and the release's sweep record is the one taken on the shipped zip; the script goes red on the parent of the fix.
